source.title: Life After Benchmark Saturation: A Case Study of CORE-Bench

read_receipt.limitation: Extracted text includes references and appendices; PDF-only graphical information and executable fidelity of extracted formulas/code unverified.

claims.claim: Author-reported task grade, process/computation and pre-existing artifact audit
claims.use_limit: Pre-existing artifact contamination only; no model-training contamination conclusion.

claims.claim: Partial reproduction with correct computation is not automatically treated as invalid
claims.use_limit: Cannot justify a mandatory full-pipeline policy from this source.

claims.claim: 39-task v1.1, 19-task OOD and operational accuracy saturation test
claims.use_limit: Not an equivalence test or whole-R&D generalization demonstration.
No local reliability effect; referenced reliability formulas were not independently read.

claims.claim: Token and contemporaneous-dollar efficiency with missing timeout resources
claims.use_limit: Historical author report; failed-run missingness prevents complete all-attempt cost interpretation.

claims.claim: Model-scaffold task disagreement, retrospective oracle and observed fix/rewrite association
claims.use_limit: Oracle is not deployed routing; observed strategy association is not randomized causal effect.

claims.claim: Harness, resource limits, retries and CLI-version differences
claims.use_limit: Configurations differ in resource policies; no isolated universal scaffold ranking.

claims.claim: Small blocked human study and log-duration fixed-effects estimate
claims.use_limit: Process time effect only, small nonrepresentative author-evaluator sample, unmodeled right-censoring.

claims.claim: Autonomous completion differs from target match and verified correctness
claims.use_limit: 19/25 autonomous completion is not reproduction correctness; ground truth was not independently verified.

local_application.houseprice_p0: Do not equate executable completion or file existence with independently scored final-artifact performance.
local_application.bcg: Hold assigned task, model/version/reasoning, environment and budget constant in a future controlled comparison; task-wise disagreements may matter beyond aggregates.
local_application.scoring: Independent final-artifact scoring is a proposed design inference, not a claimed independently verified outcome from the paper's human study.

proposed_diagnostics.name: final_artifact_score_execution_agreement
proposed_diagnostics.falsifier: Agent-reported success lacks or disagrees with independently scored artifact or current-run lineage.
proposed_diagnostics.frozen_protocol_policy: Use existing records only; do not redefine primary outcome.

proposed_diagnostics.name: all_attempt_cost_latency_missingness
proposed_diagnostics.falsifier: Equal quality with more all-attempt cost or missing failed-run costs does not establish efficiency improvement.
proposed_diagnostics.frozen_protocol_policy: Report existing accounting; no new budget or timeout changes.

proposed_diagnostics.name: repeated_outcome_resource_consistency_and_task_disagreement
proposed_diagnostics.falsifier: Consistent errors or no repeat observations do not establish correctness or reliability.
proposed_diagnostics.frozen_protocol_policy: Analyze existing repeats only; new repeats or confidence elicitation belong to a future explicit protocol.

negative_conclusions: No ARGO, graph, loop or B/C/G efficacy evidence.
No inference from saturated accuracy to validity, repeatability, efficiency or human utility.
No deployable oracle-router performance or causal targeted-fix uplift.
No transfer of human time uplift to independent reproduction correctness or local agent design.
